entry_points.text: Arming delegates to range arm with zero or derived tolerance; restart rearms absolute; forward advances periodic timers from callback time; queued and running are single reads; high-res uses static branch or false; one remaining query skips low-res adjust.

Handlers take line plus cookie and return disposition. Affinity-plus-hint delegates or returns invalid without support; wake forwards boolean; threading force is constant or branch; tasklet schedule sets bit once; timer raise uses thread when forced else direct.

User return prepares IRQs-off handling flag work then validates and transitions with arch hooks. Affinity move forwards when pending; chip-plus-handler install forwards; core invokes poll, sim, work, bypass, chip access and declared probe/init callbacks.

exports.text: Hard and soft deadlines advance together preserving gap; remaining is hard minus callback time. Ktime add, subtract and to-nanoseconds are plain integer ops.

IRQ ranges allocate and free with managed variants; number lookups expose chip, data and masks null-safely; status helpers set flags; chips register by compatible or ACPI match; sim uses request and release.

hazards.text: IRQF none 0, rising 1, falling 2, high 4, low 8, probe 0x10; shared 0x80, probe-shared 0x100, timer-int 0x200, percpu 0x400, nobal 0x800, poll 0x1000, oneshot 0x2000, nosuspend 0x4000, force-resume 0x8000, nothread 0x10000, early 0x20000, cond-susp 0x40000, noautoen 0x80000, nodebug 0x100000, cond-oneshot 0x200000; timer combines int+nosuspend+nothread; noconnect is 1u<<31; max sets 4; sense, descriptor, state and chip bits fixed.

Invalid hwirq is all-ones; default distributor priority 0xA0; ESPI base 4096 and EPPI base 1056; distributor and redistributor offsets, control bits, typer fields and priority codes are fixed; generic flags cover mask-cache, nested-lock, per-type cache, no-mask and big-endian; mask saturates at 32; user-exit work union fixed.

Queued flag uses once reads; deferred test needs IRQs disabled; timer raise asserts IRQ context; local disable warns in NMI; exits assert IRQs off; sampled fallbacks fail domain alloc and make removal, work run and affinity update no-ops.

invariants.text: Four clocks each have normal and soft variants; low-res relative remaining drops one quantum; softirqs live per-CPU ordered tasklets-first with RCU last; timer, poll, hrtimer and RCU are hotplug-safe; empty builds lack deferred rearm.

Local masking nests with per-CPU saved flags; user entry leaves user context IRQs-off; kernel entry reports context-entered; tickless flush runs only on full CPUs; one-bit helpers query state; affinity copy needs SMP.

locks.text: Line disable pairs nonsync disable with conditional local mask under lockdep; generic chip state uses its raw spinlock with optional nested init; user and kernel exits require hardware IRQs off.
SMP tasklets test-and-set run bit with blocking and spinning waits; UP always succeeds; disable bumps count then waits, enable drops it; schedule enqueues only on first set.

state_machines.text: Callbacks return no-restart or restart. Deferred rearm pends in a thread flag tested and cleared IRQs-off, consumed on user return unless reschedule pends. Tasklets use scheduled versus run bits. Chip state is pending, active, masked or line-level.

Kernel exit runs preempt check then restore; preempt skips when entry had IRQs off or context entered, else cond-reschedules; restore rearms timers and exits context or tracing. Work reports pending, busy and hard; poll uses scheduled versus disabled.

structs.text: Timer holds node, base pointer, queued flag, rel/soft/hard/lazy modes, soft expiry and restart callback. Clock base holds owner, index, clockid, seq, next expiry, running, queue and offset. Per-CPU base holds lock, cpu, active mask, set-seq, hres/deferred/hang/softirq/online flags, hard/soft/deferred deadlines, base array, signal and diagnostics.

Action links handler, cookie, affinity, thread hooks and sharing. Affinity layout, notifier and desc record masks and callbacks. Softirq is one callback. Tasklet has next, state, count, mode, function and data. Common data holds state and placement; per-chip data links common, chip, domain, parent, ids, mask and private; chip groups lifecycle, mask, config, messaging, state and NMI; entry state unions context versus validation.

Regs store six offsets; type pairs chip, offsets, flow handler, trigger and mask. Generic chip has lock, base, hooks, range, cached masks, private, domain and types; domain tables hold counts and flags. Poll has link, state, weight and callback. Work has node, callback and sync. Bypass pairs producer and consumer with event, peer and add/remove plus stop/start.
